phase: Before Reader readiness/navigation application edits; quiet-autosave feedback is independently repaired
method: Exact AST-extracted navigation/input/window-application callbacks and readiness, listener, restore, persistence and first-content effects, with real complete-turn helpers, rendered-block registry, active-target resolver and position payload builder. Query snapshots, React hooks/dependency cleanup, transport, timers, DOM geometry, block leases and target alignment are explicit deterministic doubles. Not browser/React lifecycle or real server persistence.
controls: Unresolved content remains unready; a cached-detail mount already has listeners
Normal remote/offline whole-turn and genuine empty first loads finish readiness
Programmatic scroll and saved-position restoration do not fabricate new intent or saves
Real input can cancel an active restore; failed empty target reads cannot fabricate an anchor
Cleanup removes handlers/cancels scheduled paint; ordinary refreshes do not duplicate listeners or first-content reports
failure_groups: Cold-mounted Reader listeners do not attach after detail becomes available while the initial window stays failed
Accepted independent target content cannot complete readiness or first-content reporting
Ordinary index/message navigation leaves restore admission unresolved and later valid position saves blocked
A late original-window success or pending saved restore can reclaim ownership from newer index navigation
Readiness callback does not fence retired visit/account/window state; hidden Reader listeners remain attached
